patterns.note: The site employs full-screen hero sections that occupy the entire viewport and transition on scroll, followed by a responsive grid of project cards and a full-width client marquee.
Extremely large, ultra-thin sans-serif headings are used for hero titles, creating a dramatic visual impact, contrasted with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A strictly monochrome palette of black, white, and various shades of grey is used throughout, with background colors dynamically changing between full-screen sections.

Full-screen hero sections transition with a scroll-snap effect, replacing the previous content and background color. Project cards reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport. A continuous horizontal marquee displays client names at the bottom of the page.

The site is structured into distinct full-screen hero experiences, followed by a 'Work' section presented as a grid of project cards, and a 'Clients' section as a scrolling marquee, culminating in a minimal footer.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-snapping mechanism to transition between full-screen hero sections, where each section reveals new content and a distinct background color. GSAP ScrollTrigger is likely used to orchestrate these full-page transitions and to animate individual project cards with a fade-up effect as they scroll into view. A continuous horizontal marquee animation is employed for the client logo section, creating an infinite scroll effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic contrast with oversized, ultra-thin sans-serif headings (approx. 4-5x body text) paired with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners universally applied to all elements and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and spacious in hero sections, transitioning to a balanced grid density for project cards, and a more compact but still legible footer.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its use of full-screen, scroll-snapping hero sections that dramatically transition content and background colors on scroll. This, combined with the ultra-thin, oversized typography and a strict monochrome palette, creates a highly sophisticated and editorial feel that elevates the agency's portfolio beyond typical marketing sites.
